caption: The video captures an outdoor scene dominated by a large, dry, golden grassy hill sloping beneath a bright blue sky scattered with thin white clouds. At the base of the hill, on a paved foreground area, a person dressed in dark clothing stands holding a wand-like object with arms raised. To the left of the figure, a large iridescent, tube-shaped soap bubble rests against the slope. Its elongated, sausage-like form stretches horizontally across the lower part of the hillside. Across the sequence, the person shifts position gradually toward the right side of the frame, walking slowly along the paved edge while keeping the wand held aloft. The bubble's elongated outline also extends rightward as the figure moves, so the gap between them stays roughly constant rather than widening. The iridescence on the bubble's surface shifts subtly with the light, and the sausage-like form stretches further along the slope instead of holding a fixed shape. The person's posture changes slightly with each step, while the bubble's tail continues to extend toward the figure.
